source_lines.text: 1 Introduction

blocks.text: Block translation should preserve evidence and reading order. The original document is retained. We examine reproducible analysis and scientific reasoning in two columns. The method uses paragraph-level evidence and a stable document identity. A useful value is 𝑥𝑖2 + 𝑦𝑖2 and we compare results with [1–2]. No real model is used in this fixture.
